stops.message: No specific antidote for Metal phosphides (aluminium phosphide, zinc phosphide). Do not give atropine for this exposure. Management is supportive per the cited guidance.

identity.text: Aluminium phosphide is a metal phosphide used as a fumigant.
It belongs to the metal phosphides group which includes zinc phosphide.
